flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:9925 then Log in with email {{global.email}} and password {{secrets.user.password}}.
Create a new shopping list named Double Test.
Open the recipe named Party Jollof and add its ingredients to the shopping list Double Test.
Then add the Party Jollof ingredients to Double Test a second time.
Open the Double Test shopping list and report exactly as displayed the line for rice, the line for salt, the line for tomatoes and the line for water.
Get the line for rice exactly as displayed in the Double Test shopping list and save it as {{rice_line}}.
Get the line for salt exactly as displayed in the Double Test shopping list and save it as {{salt_line}}.
Get the line for tomatoes exactly as displayed in the Double Test shopping list and save it as {{tomatoes_line}}.
Get the line for water exactly as displayed in the Double Test shopping list and save it as {{water_line}}.
